Package com.nexuslink.plugin.codegen

Class CodeGenRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.plugin.codegen.CodeGenRegistry
public final class CodeGenRegistry extends Object
Discovers the CodeGenerators on the classpath, mirroring ExtensionRegistry's contract: first registration of a protocol id wins, later collisions are reported through duplicateProtocolIds() rather than throwing, so one bad jar can't take the code-generation feature down.

The UI asks generatorsFor(Object) which generators apply to the request it holds, so a new protocol becomes code-generatable by adding a provider jar — no UI change.

      public static CodeGenRegistry fromProviders(Iterable<CodeGenerator> providers)
      Indexes an explicit set of providers — the testable seam behind load(). Iterated in order; a provider with a blank protocol id is ignored, and a second provider for an already claimed id is skipped and recorded in duplicateProtocolIds().
